whatItIs.statement: A window overlaid on the primary window or another dialog window, rendering the content underneath inert.

whenToUse.statement: Use a dialog when content should be presented in an overlaid window while the content underneath is inert.

howToUse.statement: Compose a Dialog with a trigger and content, with a header containing a title and description and a footer for actions.
Provide an accessible dialog title; a description is optional and should describe the dialog when the content is simple enough to be announced as a single message.
Keep a visible button that closes the dialog in the dialog's tab sequence.

options.statement: Set showCloseButton to false when the default close control should be hidden.

writing.statement: Give the dialog a visible title; use a description when it can be understood without requiring the listener to reconstruct complex structure.
